fact: On 16 July 2025 the national integrated malaria programme (PNILP) and Enabel's Malariya Pi project trained health providers in Cibitoke and Kirundo to use an AI app (Malariya Pi, by Audere) that automatically reads malaria rapid diagnostic tests, described as a pilot approach.
title: L'intelligence artificielle au service du diagnostic du paludisme au Burundi
